channel.title: AI Revolution — Frontier AI Models, Agents & Infrastructure News
channel.description: Weekly intelligence on frontier AI models, agents, infrastructure, regulation, and enterprise adoption.

item.title: Anthropic Hits $965B, Greenlights Mythos Wide Release
item.description: Anthropic closes a $65B round at a $965B valuation on May 29, 2026, eclipsing OpenAI's $852B, and greenlights Mythos-class models for wide release in coming weeks.

item.title: Claude Opus 4.8 Adds Dynamic Workflows + Fast Mode
item.description: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 4.8 just 41 days after 4.7 with Dynamic Workflows for parallel subagents and a Fast Mode delivering up to 2.5x output tokens per second.

item.title: ServiceNow Bets on AI Control Tower for Agent Sprawl
item.description: At Knowledge 2026, ServiceNow expanded AI Control Tower with 30 new integrations across AWS, Azure, Google, SAP, Oracle, and Workday — pitching it as the agent governance plane.

item.title: KPMG Deploys Claude to 276,000 Employees in Global Anthropic Alliance
item.description: KPMG and Anthropic on May 19, 2026 signed a global alliance giving Claude to KPMG's 276,000-person workforce and launching the KPMG Digital Gateway Powered by Claude for tax clients and private equity portfolio companies.

item.title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini 3.5 Flash and Spark Agent Land in Gemini App
item.description: Google at I/O 2026 on May 19 unveiled Gemini 3.5 Flash, a personal agent called Gemini Spark, and a new multimodal series called Gemini Omni. 3.5 Flash is now the default model in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search.

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Personal Finance with Plaid Bank Connections
item.description: OpenAI on May 15, 2026 launched a personal finance preview inside ChatGPT for Pro subscribers in the US. Using Plaid, ChatGPT connects to more than 12,000 financial institutions and surfaces portfolio, spending, and subscription dashboards.

item.title: Anthropic and SpaceX Sign Compute Deal for 300MW Colossus 1 Capacity
item.description: On May 6, 2026, Anthropic agreed to take all compute capacity at SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center in Memphis — more than 300 megawatts and over 220,000 NVIDIA GPUs — and immediately raised Claude API and Claude Code usage limits.

item.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5.5 Instant as New Default ChatGPT Model
item.description: OpenAI on May 5, 2026 began rolling out GPT-5.5 Instant as the new default ChatGPT model. It replaces GPT-5.3 Instant, cuts hallucination on legal, medical, and financial queries, and keeps the low-latency profile of the Instant tier.

item.title: Microsoft Agent 365 Hits General Availability with Cross-Cloud Registry and Local Agent Controls
item.description: On May 1, 2026, Microsoft made Agent 365 generally available at $15 per user per month with a unified observe-govern-secure control plane, cross-cloud registry sync with AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud, and Defender/Intune local agent management on Windows endpoints.

item.title: Anthropic Opens Claude Security to Enterprises in Public Beta for Vulnerability Scanning
item.description: On April 30, 2026, Anthropic released Claude Security as a global public beta for Claude Enterprise customers, adding scheduled scans, validated findings, and CSV/Markdown exports built on Opus 4.7.

item.title: Salesforce Launches Agentforce Operations to Automate Back-Office Bottlenecks
item.description: On April 29, 2026, Salesforce announced the general availability of Agentforce Operations — AI agents that complete back-office work end-to-end with 30+ pre-built blueprints and Instant Blueprints document parsing.

item.title: OpenAI Models and Codex Land on AWS Bedrock as Microsoft Exclusivity Ends
item.description: On April 27 and 28, 2026, OpenAI ended Microsoft Azure exclusivity and made its models, Codex coding agent, and Bedrock Managed Agents available on AWS — the largest distribution shift in OpenAI's history.
